text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak witnesses a graduation ceremony at the military engineering college.
- Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid says the yield of privatisation of state-owned firms was four folds their book value.
- Mubarak to receive Libyan Unity Affairs Minister Jomaa al-Fezzani today. Fezzani carries a message from Libyan Leader Muammar Gaddafi. Foreign Minister Amr Moussa met Fezzani yesterday.
- Foreign Minister Amr Moussa discussed with senior Palestinian official, Nabil Shaath, an Egyptian intiative to save the peace process. Shaath described the current situation as very difficult.

- Egypt and the European Investment Bank signed a memo of understanding to finance infrastructure projects. Planning and International Cooperation Minister Zafer el-Bishri said the bank would provide the equivalent of 400 million pounds ($117 million) of finance annually.
